params.body: Flat painted tones, lightest to darkest by the darkness thresholds, then the lace layered over them with Lerp.
params.title: Body and lace

params.body: One Dot weighs the stamp count, a slow noise and the sun (which thins it out), plus a fixed bias in w. Each AA Step threshold moves to the next, darker tone.
params.title: Darkness

params.body: The open water between rosettes and the creases where they touch, as one crisp mask: AA Step cuts depth at an edge that breathes with the refraction, widens under the sun and backs off where stamps are, with a Clamp so overlapping stamps bite no more than one.
params.title: Lace

params.body: The mesh UV, centered and scaled to pattern space, +y toward the bottom. p is the space every layer reads.
params.title: Pond space

params.body: Two noise reads scroll at their own speed and angle. Together they give one offset that bends every layer the same way, so the whole pattern sways like water; the rosettes bend a little more. breath makes the lace breathe with them.
params.title: Refraction

params.body: Voronoi F1 grows a round disc around each cell center; a finer Voronoi scallops the rim with bumps. Where two rosettes touch, the cell edge (F2 − F1) cuts a thin crease. depth is how far inside a rosette a point lies.
params.title: Rosettes

params.body: Three more Voronoi reads, at other scales and two of them rotated, cut into round dabs with AA Step. A Dot counts the dabs a point is in; that count, only inside the rosettes, darkens the water.
params.title: Stamps

params.body: Rotate 2D turns the pond to the light angle, so one Split gives the distance across the light and along it. The band is a sharp Gaussian core plus a wide glow, fading along from where the light enters (each one a single Exp). A slight left-to-right gradient keeps the shade from going flat.
params.title: Sun band

params.body: Each tone blends its shade, mid and sun colors by the light: shade to mid while the light rises to the mid light (0.3), then on to sun. toMid and toSun are those two stretches, each clamped to 0..1.
params.title: Tones

params.body: The pond darkens toward the edges of the view, in screen space: the distance from the center, stretched sideways, becomes a factor the color is multiplied by.
params.title: Vignette
